description: This file defines an interface for a client connection retry filter in an Orleans cluster, along with an internal implementation that applies a linear backoff strategy for retry attempts.

classes.name: LinearBackoffClientConnectionRetryFilter
classes.description: Implements a retry filter applying linear backoff for reconnect attempts, based on the number of retries and delay parameters.

methods.name: ShouldRetryConnectionAttempt
methods.description: Determines whether to retry the connection attempt based on the exception, current retry count, and cancellation status.
